about.label: About the Lab
about.heading: Advancing software engineering education and research
about.p1: The Software Engineering Laboratory is a research and development unit under the Department of Information Technology at Politeknik Negeri Malang. We serve as a hub where students, faculty, and industry partners collaborate on software engineering projects, research initiatives, and innovation.
about.p2: Our laboratory provides an environment where theoretical knowledge meets practical application. Through hands-on projects, workshops, and collaborative research, we prepare the next generation of software engineers to tackle real-world challenges.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: To be a leading software engineering laboratory that drives innovation, fosters collaboration, and produces impactful research and talent for the global technology landscape.
